description: This file contains unit tests for the ConnectionModified class within the connectivity signals events of the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies hash code, equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path retrieval.

classes.name: ConnectionModifiedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the ConnectionModified class, testing equality, immutability, JSON conversion, resource path, and exception cases.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that ConnectionModified correctly implements hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ConnectionModified instances are immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnection
methods.description: Tests that creating ConnectionModified with null connection throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that JSON deserialization yields the expected ConnectionModified instance.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method produces the expected JSON object.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getResourcePath returns the correct JsonPointer.
